climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: Australia's southernmost wine state, with a cooler climate that can make distinctly different wines from the mainland. Pinot Noir is almost half of plantings, followed by Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc. Warming has helped grapes ripen fully.
